selected_proposals.selection_rationale: Primary exploitation of the generation_018/proposal_005 frontier signal: adds a bounded rank-2 Cartesian tensor-product sibling while explicitly preserving the existing scalar-vector TP branch and force-from-energy contract.
Lower-risk readout-only companion for the same rank-2 TP mechanism; isolates whether the new angular signal helps when applied after message passing with minimal disturbance to vector_state.

Tiny calibration exploit of the already-successful TP branch; useful as a low-budget interpretability/control point for whether residual-scale calibration, not new mechanism complexity, is the next bottleneck.
Selects the broadest evidence-grounded hybrid: rank-2 TP plus CACE ν=2 consistency, testing whether the frontier TP signal and a more principled invariant body-order branch combine constructively.
Selects the clean CACE ν=2 descriptor-consistency branch as a mechanism-distinct jump that keeps the TP path intact while replacing ad-hoc body-order behavior with a structured invariant descriptor.
Tests whether the frontier TP branch is bottlenecked by radial/angular resolution rather than mechanism form; keeps the intervention bounded to code-level capacity and a very small rank-2 gate.
Backward-simplify diagnostic: preserves the successful TP branch while reducing the body-order side branch, clarifying whether body-order complexity is helping or diluting the frontier signal.
Exact source replicate control is required to calibrate generation_019 variance before attributing small Q_total, energy, force, or gap changes to mechanism edits.

selection_policy: Prioritize continuation of the generation_018/proposal_005 explicit scalar-vector tensor-product frontier win while preserving branch diversity. Select three TP-focused exploit probes, three evidence-grounded jump variants spanning rank-2 TP/CACE/radial-resolution axes, one backward-simplify diagnostic that tests body-order dilution, and one exact control replicate. Defer proposals dominated by training-schedule-only or warmup-only changes so this batch remains mechanism-centric and interpretable.
selected_mechanism_axes: GEN019-M01: rank-2 Cartesian tensor-product sibling/readout adapter
TP residual-scale calibration and radial-resolution bottleneck tests
Body-order simplification diagnostic against the frontier TP source

omitted_proposals.reason: Training-objective energy-tail schedule is useful but less mechanism-centric and risks repeating prior objective-schedule diagnostics; defer until architectural TP/CACE/radial axes are measured.

Rank-2 gate with late training warmup overlaps strongly with selected proposal_001 while adding schedule confounding; select the cleaner rank-2 mechanism first and revisit warmup if instability appears.
